name: learnmate-ai
description: LearnMate AI - AI-Powered Student Learning & Teacher Support Platform (SIH 2026)

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){execSync('npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}else{execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'})}"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
